boundaries: The parent repository is private; a successful GitHub push proves remote availability, not access by an independent collaborator identity.

The local loopback preview and its token are runtime evidence only and are not a public deployment.
The browser receipt covers the retained bounded journey; the intentionally skipped canonical network probe remains outside this acceptance claim.

The retained browser acceptance receipt passed with no browser errors or outbound requests and includes a screenshot witness.
